SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_dental_70(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	result int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result10 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result11 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result12 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result01 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result02 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result03 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result04 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result05 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result06 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result07 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result08 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result09 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_dental_70 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_dental_70
( 
SELECT 
	@id,HOSPCODE,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
	,IFNULL(result.A,0) ,IFNULL(result.t10,0),IFNULL(result.t11,0),IFNULL(result.t12,0)
	,IFNULL(result.t01,0),IFNULL(result.t02,0),IFNULL(result.t03,0),IFNULL(result.t04,0)
,IFNULL(result.t05,0),IFNULL(result.t06,0),IFNULL(result.t07,0),IFNULL(result.t08,0),IFNULL(result.t09,0)

FROM chospital h INNER JOIN
 (SELECT p.HOSPCODE
				,COUNT(DISTINCT p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv) A 
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(10),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t10
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(11),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t11
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(12),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t12
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(01),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t01
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(02),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t02
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(03),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t03
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(04),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t04
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(05),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t05
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(06),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t06
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(07),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t07
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(08),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t08
				,COUNT(DISTINCT if(month(DATE_SERV) in(09),concat(p.hospcode,p.pid,p.seq,p.date_serv),null) ) t09
	FROM tmp_procedure_opd p
			INNER JOIN cwh_dent_icd10tm i ON p.PROCEDCODE=i.ICD10TM 
			INNER JOIN provider v ON p.hospcode=v.hospcode AND p.provider=v.provider AND v.providertype in(2,6)
	WHERE p.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  
	GROUP BY p.HOSPCODE
	) result ON result.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode 

WHERE h.provcode=@prov_c 
GROUP BY h.hoscode 
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name,  sum("result") as "result", sum("result10") as "m10", sum("result11") as "m11", sum("result12") as "m12", sum("result01") as "m01", sum("result02") as "m02", sum("result03") as "m03", sum("result04") as "m04", sum("result05") as "m05", sum("result06") as "m06", sum("result07") as "m07", sum("result08") as "m08", sum("result09") as "m09" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
